name: tailwindcss
description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
one_liner: A tool that lets web developers style a website quickly by writing small reusable labels in their code instead of custom style files.
buyer: A freelance web developer who builds client websites fast and wants a reliable, familiar styling system to protect their margins on fixed-price projects.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it as their default stack for client sites, delivering faster and keeping more margin on fixed-price work.
A template seller builds and sells a library of Tailwind component kits (hero sections, pricing tables, dashboards).
An agency runs 'redesign your outdated website' packages, using Tailwind to deliver cheaply and quickly.

money_ideas.idea: Sell packs of Tailwind UI component templates

steal_this: Build and sell a small pack of Tailwind component templates (pricing table, hero section, dashboard) this weekend on a marketplace like Gumroad.
